{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DataKinds #-}
{-# LANGUAGE TypeOperators #-}

module GrpcValidation where

import Text.Regex.PCRE ((=~))
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

-- Rate limiter state
data RateLimiter = RateLimiter
  { rlRequests :: IORef (Map.Map String [UTCTime])
  , rlMaxPerWindow :: Int
  , rlWindowSecs :: NominalDiffTime
  }

-- Request context from gRPC metadata
data RequestContext = RequestContext
  { rcClientId :: String
  , rcPayload :: String
  , rcRetryCount :: Int
  , rcMaxRetries :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

-- Validation result
data ValidationResult
  = Valid
  | Invalid String
  | RateLimited
  | RetryExhausted
  deriving (Show, Eq)

-- Initialize rate limiter
newRateLimiter :: Int -> NominalDiffTime -> IO RateLimiter
newRateLimiter maxReqs window = do
  ref <- newIORef Map.empty
  return $ RateLimiter ref maxReqs window

-- Check rate limit for a client
checkRateLimit :: RateLimiter -> String -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit rl clientId = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let cutoff = addUTCTime (negate $ rlWindowSecs rl) now
  reqMap <- readIORef (rlRequests rl)
  let clientReqs = fromMaybe [] (Map.lookup clientId reqMap)
      recentReqs = filter (> cutoff) clientReqs
      allowed = length recentReqs < rlMaxPerWindow rl
  when allowed $ do
    modifyIORef' (rlRequests rl) $
      Map.insert clientId (now : recentReqs)
  return allowed

-- The core validation regex pattern for structured message format
-- Validates: HEADER{key=value,...}BODY{content}FOOTER{checksum}
-- This pattern uses nested quantifiers for thorough validation
messageFormatPattern :: String
messageFormatPattern =
  "^HEADER\\{([a-zA-Z0-9]+=[a-zA-Z0-9 ]*,?\\s*)+\\}" ++
  "BODY\\{([^}]*|\\{[^}]*\\})*\\}" ++
  "FOOTER\\{[a-fA-F0-9]+\\}$"

-- Validate the message structure
validateMessageFormat :: String -> Bool
validateMessageFormat msg = msg =~ messageFormatPattern

-- Sanitize input - basic length and character checks
sanitizeInput :: String -> Either String String
sanitizeInput input
  | length input > 4096 = Left "Input exceeds maximum length"
  | any (\c -> fromEnum c > 127) input = Left "Non-ASCII characters detected"
  | otherwise = Right input

-- Process a single request with retry logic
processRequest :: RateLimiter -> RequestContext -> IO ValidationResult
processRequest rl ctx = do
  -- Check retry budget
  if rcRetryCount ctx >= rcMaxRetries ctx
    then return RetryExhausted
    else do
      -- Check rate limit
      allowed <- checkRateLimit rl (rcClientId ctx)
      if not allowed
        then do
          -- Exponential backoff before retry
          let delayMs = min 5000 (100 * (2 ^ rcRetryCount ctx))
          threadDelay (delayMs * 1000)
          let retryCtx = ctx { rcRetryCount = rcRetryCount ctx + 1 }
          processRequest rl retryCtx
        else do
          -- Sanitize then validate
          case sanitizeInput (rcPayload ctx) of
            Left err -> return $ Invalid err
            Right sanitized -> do
              -- Apply format validation
              if validateMessageFormat sanitized
                then return Valid
                else return $ Invalid "Message format validation failed"

-- Handle incoming gRPC unary call
handleValidateMessage :: RateLimiter -> String -> String -> IO ValidationResult
handleValidateMessage rl clientId payload = do
  let ctx = RequestContext
        { rcClientId = clientId
        , rcPayload = payload
        , rcRetryCount = 0
        , rcMaxRetries = 3
        }
  processRequest rl ctx

-- Batch validation endpoint
handleBatchValidate :: RateLimiter -> String -> [String] -> IO [ValidationResult]
handleBatchValidate rl clientId payloads = do
  mapM (handleValidateMessage rl clientId) payloads

-- Health check - validates service is responsive
healthCheck :: RateLimiter -> IO Bool
healthCheck rl = do
  let testMsg = "HEADER{test=value}BODY{hello}FOOTER{deadbeef}"
  result <- handleValidateMessage rl "__health__" testMsg
  return $ result == Valid
